Hi <@402853454126776320> quoting the hackmd, what I'm looking after answering is this bit: > 3. Why not charge account creation inside of create-frame? > > It introduces a semantic change silently. Currently (before 8037) the account creation is pre-charged before the create-frame and OOG the parent frame if budget is insufficient. Re-locating the account creation into the create-frame will OOG the child frame only if budget is insufficient. > > This behavior change may introduce some unexpected compatibility issue for on-chain contracts. I'm looking at the code in @main for besu and I can't seem to find where the account creation is charged in advance. From what I can see charges are only the following: - txCreateCost() (32000) - memoryExpansionGasCost - reading the initcode from memory - initcodeCost(inputSize) — EIP-3860 word cost - CREATE2 only: keccakCost(inputSize) for hashing the initcode Is this something that was introduced in current devnet and I might not be synced with the latest? Can you show me where you are doing it in Geth? The 32k cost includes the cost of account creation. It always assumed the account was always new, i.e. there were no refunds in case the account already existed

excerpts.content:
Hi <@402853454126776320> quoting the hackmd, what I'm looking after answering is this bit:

> 3. Why not charge account creation inside of create-frame?
> 
> It introduces a semantic change silently. Currently (before 8037) the account creation is pre-charged before the create-frame and OOG the parent frame if budget is insufficient. Re-locating the account creation into the create-frame will OOG the child frame only if budget is insufficient.
> 
> This behavior change may introduce some unexpected compatibility issue for on-chain contracts.

I'm looking at the code in @main for besu and I can't seem to find where the account creation is charged in advance. From what I can see charges are only the following:
  - txCreateCost() (32000)
  - memoryExpansionGasCost - reading the initcode from memory
  - initcodeCost(inputSize) — EIP-3860 word cost
  - CREATE2 only: keccakCost(inputSize) for hashing the initcode
Is this something that was introduced in current devnet and I might not be synced with the latest? Can you show me where you are doing it in Geth?

excerpts.content: The 32k cost includes the cost of account creation. It always assumed the account was always new, i.e. there were no refunds in case the account already existed
